purpose: Explain attenuation of the PushT effect without changing or rescuing the failed preregistered external thresholds.
mechanistic_hypothesis: The external effect may be diluted because many one-step PushT interventions weakly couple the agent action to T-block motion; if so, low/high model error separation should be larger on contact-coupled transitions than on non-contact transitions.
data_policy: Reuse the exact frozen anchor seeds, local offsets, model architecture, optimizer settings, training seeds, and counterfactual actions. Re-execute deterministic PushT transitions only to recover per-sample physics diagnostics and predictions that were not stored in the original aggregate artifact.
required_reproduction_check: Before mechanism summaries are accepted, each replicate must reproduce all four original aggregate MSE values (factual low/high and counterfactual low/high) within relative tolerance 1e-5 and absolute tolerance 1e-12.

primary_descriptive_split.name: contact
report: paired-bootstrap 95% CI for geometric-mean replicate ratio

block_motion.definition: one-step T-block translation magnitude > 1e-4 pixels versus <= 1e-4 pixels

action_alignment.definition: cosine between local target offset and initial agent-to-block center vector

statistics.interpretation: descriptive/explanatory only; cannot convert the failed external test into confirmation

stop_rule: Report all predefined splits regardless of whether they support the mechanistic hypothesis. Do not tune action scale, anchor filter, model, bins, or thresholds after seeing mechanism outputs.
